drone-pilot-pathway.summary: Barbados requires permission from the Prime Minister's Office before any drone flight. The Civil Aviation Authority page asks for a device training certificate, a spectrum licence and public liability insurance; visitors are not addressed.

items.text: No public register of drone operators was found on the BCAA page.

Apply through the Prime Minister's Office before flying a drone in Barbados airspace. Operators need the training certificate for their device, a spectrum licence and public liability insurance with at least a 250,000 minimum cover (currency as stated on the page: dollars). Flights stay below 400 feet, and air traffic control at Grantley Adams airport is notified 15 minutes before and after flying.
Not stated: the page does not address visitors or foreign operators.

The page says flights are prohibited beyond visual range, over people, over populated areas, in prohibited or restricted areas and within 5 km of a controlled aerodrome's movement area, sensitive government areas or police stations; stay 50 m from crowds or buildings. Free-to-fly zones (with approval, a licensed and insured drone) are Sterling, Lynches, Dash Valley, College Savannah and Vaucluse.
